thread:
alina: quick sync 00 — noticed per-route analytics with model cards causes a big cold load (p95 ~2.0s). appears to be N+1 model-metrics calls. anyone looked into this?

marco: yep. client flow: /api/route/summary then for each pinned model GET /api/model/stats. two roundtrips + DOM join.

jess: obvious backend fix = aggregate endpoint that returns route + model metrics in one response. also lets us add a single cache key and S-W-R header.

raf: product wrinkle: aggregated payload increases telemetry consumption. some customers have strict telemetry budgets. we need a consent/opt-in UX or an "auto" mode.

alina: suggestion: saved-query schema gets telemetry_prefetch: "off"|"on"|"auto". default off for new accounts, auto for enterprise trials.

marco: API sketch: GET /api/console/views/{id}?prefetch=models&sample=0.15&cache=30
Response meta: "prefetch_status":"served_full|sampled|downgraded", "sample_rate":"0.15", "quota_signal":"ok|throttled"

jess: client reads meta and shows banner when sampled/downgraded: "Detailed model metrics sampled (15% of events)" or "Downgraded to route-level due to quota". small tooltip explains cost.

raf: billing/ops ask: include meter tag console.view.telemetry with org_id and view_id. emit event telemetry.downgraded when fallback happens. also ensure cache-hit still pings billing.

infra-bot: perf: staging run cprefetch-2026-03-25 -> median load 380ms (baseline 1.9s), p95 940ms (baseline 3.3s).

alina: rollout plan: feature-flag endpoint -> client toggle persisted on saved views -> opt-in beta for orgs with sufficient quota -> default off GA.

marco: I'll take the combined endpoint PR and add X-Prefetch-Status header. will prototype downgrade logic + cache-control.

jess: I'll add the saved-query field and client UI. will sketch microcopy: "Include per-model telemetry (may increase telemetry usage)" with tooltip.

raf: I'll own billing hooks and meter definitions. add acceptance criteria to umbrella ticket: combined endpoint, persisted saved-view flag, visible quota/cost hint, downgrade meters, session caching with billing pings.

alina: thanks. let's keep messaging transparent so customers know when numbers are sampled. reconvene after initial PRs. :raised_hands:

end of thread
